about.title: Curriculum Vitae
about.summary: A journey of struggle and success from simple trade to investment and economics, with an ambitious political vision for Egypt's future.
about.content:
The journey of Mr. Mahmoud Ramadan spans diverse paths combining economic, industrial, and investment work, cultural and intellectual activity, public affairs engagement, and a commitment to societal and human development. Over years of work and experience, these paths converged to create a journey that transcends single specialization, reflecting a vision that genuine development is not limited to one domain, but is the result of the interaction between economy and thought, action and knowledge, and individual success with social responsibility.

Born in Cairo on September 29, 1968, he obtained a Bachelor of Laws from Ain Shams University in 1990, continuing his academic pursuit by earning a Master's degree in Law from Ain Shams University in 2012. His legal background helped form a legislative and administrative perspective that accompanied different stages of his professional life, visibly influencing his economic projects, intellectual writings, and public concerns.

His journey reveals a set of interconnected dimensions that provide insight into understanding his experience and distinct characteristics.

First: The Scientific and Academic Dimension
The scientific aspect represents one of the fundamental pillars in shaping Mahmoud Ramadan's personality, as he was keen to combine practical experience with academic grounding.
Academic Qualifications:
• Bachelor of Laws – Ain Shams University (1990).
• Master of Laws – Ain Shams University (2012).

In addition to obtaining numerous specialized training courses in negotiation, marketing, leadership, communication skills, crisis management, import and export, shipping and customs clearance, administration, and other related fields.
This academic formation contributed to building a solid knowledge base and a strong legal and administrative background, clearly reflected in his various professional activities and intellectual contributions.

________________________________________

Second: The Economic, Leadership, and Institutional Dimension
Economic activity and institution-building represent the most prominent axis in Mahmoud Ramadan's career, as his journey was linked to founding, managing, and developing a diverse group of companies and projects operating in various sectors.

Key companies and institutions he founded or led:
• MRG Group of Companies.                          • United Company for Trade & Agencies.
• Suez Polyester Factories.                        • Pure Plast for Packaging.
• VIA PURE Medical & Cosmetic Company.         • Maran Sports Investment Company.
• I Talent for Training.                         • دار طفرة للنشر والتوزيع.
• Ramadan Foundation for Economic Development.

• A ONE
• Ard El Zahab
• SUS
• Fox Sign

Economic and Professional Memberships:
• Member of the Federation of Egyptian Industries.
• Member of the Cairo Chamber of Commerce.
• Member of the Canadian Business Council.
• Member of the Egyptian Society for Political Economy, Statistics and Legislation.
This career reflects a clear direction towards building an integrated business ecosystem that combines industry, trade, culture, education, investment, development, and services, contributing to supporting economic activity and creating job opportunities.

________________________________________

Third: The Intellectual and Cultural Dimension
Thought and culture represent a central space in Mahmoud Ramadan's experience, linked to writing, publishing, knowledge production, and documenting ideas and experiences.

Cultural Institutions:
• Founder & Chairman of Tafra Publishing and Distribution House. • Conceptualizer of the Encyclopedia of Great Egypt.
• Conceptualizer of the Encyclopedia of Notable Figures of Egyptian Governorates. • Conceptualizer of the Symbols & Codes Encyclopedia.

Cultural Memberships:
• Member of the Egyptian Publishers Association. • Member of the Arab Publishers Association.

Published Works:
1. The People Want a New System. 2. All for Egypt.
3. Where is Egypt? 4. If I Were President of Egypt.
5. Articles and Quotes. 6. From the Finest Words of Humanity.
7. We Shall Not Die. 8. Mahmoud's Words.

Upcoming Works:
• Feelings. • Stories From My Life. • We Deserve Failure. • My Will to My Children. • No. • Let Us Contemplate. • Egypt 80 + 20. • It Will Be Better. • A Different Time.
This production reflects a deep commitment to intellectual, social, developmental, and humanitarian issues, alongside documenting personal and public insights.

________________________________________

Fourth: The Social and Developmental Dimension
His journey has been associated with a distinct focus on community development, rooted in the belief that the impact of economic success must extend to serving society and humanity.

Developmental Institutions:
• Ramadan Foundation for Economic Development.
Areas of Focus:
• Supporting economic and social development. • Contributing to charitable and developmental initiatives.
• Encouraging a culture of corporate social responsibility. • Backing high-impact community projects.

________________________________________

Fifth: The Educational and Training Dimension
Mahmoud Ramadan prioritized capacity-building and knowledge transfer, considering investment in human capital one of the most vital pathways to progress.

Educational & Training Institutions:
• I Talent for Training.
Areas of Activity:
• Administrative and professional training. • Personal and leadership skill development.
• Preparing human cadres for the labor market.

________________________________________

Sixth: The Sports Dimension
Sports investment is one of the avenues he pursued as part of his strategy to diversify business and investment activities.

Sports Entities:
• Maran Sports Investment Company.
Areas of Focus:
• Investing in sports activities. • Supporting sports initiatives. • Contributing to developing the sports sector.

________________________________________

Seventh: The Political and Reform Dimension
Mahmoud Ramadan maintained a dedicated interest in public affairs and national questions, driven by faith in community engagement and presenting visions to enhance reality.

Key Political Milestones:
• Presidential nomination bid (2012).
• Presidential nomination bid (2014).
• Candidacy for the House of Representatives (2015).
• Presidential nomination bid (2018).

Key reform vision points presented in his book 'If I Were President of Egypt':
• Proposing frameworks to address economic and social challenges.
• Offering insights for reforming public administration.
• Focus on human-centered development.
• Calling for practical, applicable solutions across various sectors.

________________________________________

Eighth: The National and Humanitarian Dimension
This dimension represents the common thread across all milestones of his career, connecting economic, intellectual, cultural, and community activities with a steadfast concern for the nation, humanity, and progress.
This has been reflected in his diverse projects, his writing and publishing, his public participation, his support for development initiatives, and his continuous pursuit of ideas that shape the future of Egyptian society.

item1.title: Egyptians: First Candidate for the 2018 Presidential Election
item1.excerpt: Businessman Mahmoud Ramadan announced his intention to run for the 2018 presidential election after finalizing his electoral program aimed at pulling Egypt out of crises.

item2.title: Potential Presidential Candidate Explains Reasons for Running
item2.excerpt: Mahmoud Ramadan, a potential presidential candidate, stated that his candidacy stems from a lifelong concern for public affairs and a persistent worry about the reasons behind Egypt's weakness.

item1.title: Egyptians are the First to the Blessings of Their Country
item1.excerpt: The goal is to prioritize Egyptian investment while encouraging foreign investment that the Egyptian economy needs.
item1.content: The aim is to prioritize Egyptian investment, while also encouraging foreign investment that the Egyptian economy requires and that adds new value.

item2.title: Egyptian Situation and Economy
item2.excerpt: The current state of the Egyptian economy is that we do not genuinely invest in building the Egyptian person.
item2.content: The current state of the Egyptian economy is that we do not genuinely invest in building the Egyptian person... leading us to export labor abroad and import investors to work here.

item3.title: The Book 'The People Want a New System'
item3.excerpt: I wrote my ideas in a very concise manner and compiled them into a small 52-page book titled 'The People Want a New System'.
item3.content: I wrote my ideas in a very concise manner and compiled them into a small 52-page book titled 'The People Want a New System', registered with the Egyptian Book House under deposit number 3704/2012.
